paragraph: Ho-Ho-Kus is a single-family market and nothing else. Thirty-seven sales over six months at a median of $1,525,000, with a sale-to-list ratio of exactly 1.00, about 46 percent of homes closing above asking, and a median of 17 days on market. That is competitive but not frenzied. Well-priced homes move quickly, and the ones that linger are usually asking more than the comparable sales support. Sales ran from $840,000 to $4,950,000, so the median is the better guide than the average here. Volume built into June and July as expected, and the monthly median eased from $1,850,000 in May to $1,400,000 in July on higher closing counts, which reads as a shift toward mid-range homes rather than a drop in values. If the usual seasonal arc holds, expect closings to thin out through the fall.
